de.abas.erp.db

Interface DbContext

  • All Superinterfaces:
    AutoCloseable, Closeable
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    DbServerContext

    public interface DbContext
extends Closeable
    Base class for a database context. A database context establishes the connection to the database and is the main entry point for all database operations. This abstract class works also as a static factory for context instances. One can create either a server or a client context.

    • Method Detail

      • createStringLock

        Lock createStringLock(String string)
        Creates a lock for a string identifier. Can be used to synchronize access to critical sections over multiple database contexts. A String lock can only be released by his owner context. A String lock is reentrant, lock can be called multiple times by his owner. If other context can acquire this lock depends on the lock mode.
        Parameters:
        string - A string identifier.
        Returns:
        A lock that can obtain an release string locks

      • load

        <T extends SelectableRecord> T load(Class<T> type,
                                    Id id)
        Loads the object with id and type T. If type is assignable from Group, the table descriptor is determined using this type if needed to (if header of T is quoted). Objects can also be loaded in Editors.
        Type Parameters:
        T - Type
        Parameters:
        type - Class instance of type T
        id - Id of object to load.
        If you have an Id as String, e.g. "(2390,3,0)", simply use a new Instance of IdImpl, e.g. new IdImpl("(2390,3,0)").
        See also IdImpl(String).
        Returns:
        A SelectableRecord instance of object with id, if a record with this id is available in the database.
        Else: null.

      • getEnvironmentVariable

        String getEnvironmentVariable(String environmentVariableName)
                       throws DBRuntimeException
        Reads the server side environment variable with given environmentVariableName.

        Note that this reflects the server side ERP processe's environment which was effective at the time the process (eksanw, epi or pa) was started. This is not necessarily equal to the JFOP-Server's environment that can be read using java's System Properties when run within the JFOP-Server's JVM.
        Parameters:
        environmentVariableName - The server-side environment variable's name.
        Returns:
        The server side environment variable value for given environmentVariableName.
        An empty String "", if a variable with that name exists but is empty.
        null, otherwise (i.e. a variable with that name does not exist).
        Throws:
        DBRuntimeException - Thrown when getting the value of environmentVariableName fails.

      • loadProcedure

        Loads the Procedure which is specified by procedure.
        Type Parameters:
        P - An extension of Procedure from package de.abas.erp.db.procedures or, in case of disabled type detection, one of the Interfaces Procedure or ProcedureQuery.
        R - The ProcedureResult, is inferred automatically using the given parameter <P>.
        Parameters:
        procedure - The procedure class from package de.abas.erp.db.procedures or, in case of disabled type detection, one of the Interfaces Procedure or ProcedureQuery.
        Returns:
        An instance of the given procedure. Use its Setters to set parameters and execute the procedure by invoking Procedure.execute().
